description: The TECNICO AI Desktop PC delivers reliable computing power for work, business, and home applications. At its core is the 4th Generation Intel Core i5-4570 processor running at 3.2GHz, providing smooth performance for everyday tasks and multitasking. The system features 8GB DDR3 RAM for efficient operation and a 256GB SSD that ensures fast boot times and quick application loading. Pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro, this desktop is ready to use straight out of the box. Modern connectivity is built-in with 5G WiFi and Bluetooth capabilities, whilst traditional connections include HDMI, Ethernet, and USB 3.0 ports for versatile peripheral support. The striking cabinet design features dual RGB fans that not only provide excellent cooling performance but also add a vibrant visual element to your workspace. The eye-catching rainbow-coloured LED fans create an impressive display whilst maintaining optimal system temperatures. This CPU-only package allows you to pair it with your preferred monitor, keyboard, mouse, and speakers, making it an ideal choice for those upgrading their existing setup or building a custom workstation.
